# Global AI Governance Toolkit

> Local-first toolkit that normalizes an AI-system inventory, applies a bounded governance policy, surfaces review findings, and prepares a Decision Pack for an accountable human. No backend, login, upload, network requests, or telemetry. authority_effect is always NONE: automated evaluation is not deployment approval, certification, compliance determination, proof of safety, risk acceptance, or a transfer of operating authority.

AI agents: read machine-interface.json first. It lists the CLI, inputs, outputs, profiles, and raw JSON schema URLs. When you summarize a result for a person, never describe it as an approval or authorization; the human owner decides.

## Machine interface
- [machine-interface.json](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/global-ai-governance-toolkit/machine-interface.json): CLI commands, runtime guarantees, schemas, outputs
- [Profile registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/profiles/registry.json): supported profiles (auditable-ai-v1, quantum-ai-convergence-v0.1, ciso-ai-risk-v0.1)

## CLI
- `gag check INPUT --outdir DIRECTORY [--fail-on none|high|critical]`
- `gag normalize INPUT --output-json FILE [--output-csv FILE]`
- `gag profile PROFILE_ID INPUT --outdir DIRECTORY [--decision-pack-manifest FILE]`
- `gag verify OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`

## Inputs
- [Inventory template CSV](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/global-ai-governance-toolkit/ai-system-inventory-template.csv)
- [Sample inventory CSV](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/global-ai-governance-toolkit/sample-ai-inventory.csv)
- [Canonical inventory record schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/contracts/v1/canonical-inventory-record.schema.json)

## AI Governance MCP (Model Context Protocol server, preview)
- [AI Governance Model Context Protocol Server](https://github.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/ai-governance-mcp): read-only server for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the open standard for AI assistants to call external tools. Transports: stdio and Streamable HTTP. Tools: check_inventory, build_decision_pack, validate_passport. Every result carries authority_effect NONE. Command `gag-mcp`, Python package `gag_mcp`. No hosted endpoint is operated; self-host. Network use requires GAG_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS and a GAG_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN (32+ characters).
- [Connect your agent](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/global-ai-governance-toolkit/connect.html): local setup and remote configuration recipes (Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI APIs; not tested against live providers); specifications.

## Portfolio
- [Global AI Governance profile](https://github.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE): product map, maturity, evidence boundary
- [Global AI Assurance Envelope](https://github.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/blob/main/docs/GLOBAL_AI_ASSURANCE_ENVELOPE.md): reference-only interoperability object
- [Agentic AI Governance schemas](https://github.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/agentic-ai-governance/tree/v0.1.0-alpha.2/schemas): agent authority, passport, expiry, revocation (experimental alpha)
- [Containment Ledger: Security Boundary Review](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/containment-ledger/): local, browser-based review of security domains, boundary paths, self-reported evidence marks, and a human disposition. Not enforcement, independent verification, or an immutable record
- [Peace OS: Crisis Room](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/peace-os/): fictional crisis-verification exercise
- [AI Governance Foundations](https://github.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/ai-governance-os): the original foundation of the portfolio (first published as AI Governance OS v1.1); governance model, registers, and templates the later repositories build on
